0x0008FE.en: 「If this is all I've got...@　then this is where it ends...!」

0x00096F.en: 「Ugh! @　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0009F7.en: 「Dammit! @　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A71.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000B58.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000C21.en: 「Tch! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000C5C.en: 「Like hell I'll screw up here...!@　This ain't fun...」

0x000CB0.en: 「I blew it...!@　Guess I've got no choice but to bail...」

0x000D24.en: 「Ugh! Guess I've got to fall back!!」

0x000E01.en: 「So this is it...... The rest is up to you.」

0x000E6F.en: 「Nngh! So they got the drop on me......」

0x000EAD.en: 「No good, we've taken too much damage...... Falling back!」

0x000EFA.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000F38.en: 「Eek! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x00102A.en: 「Ngh... Guess I'm going out like a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x0010E1.en: 「Owowow... You got me. Miscalculation on my part.」

0x001122.en: 「Aw, man, they went and got me!」

0x001166.en: 「Uh...ngh! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x0011D3.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00121A.en: 「I'm sorry... The rest is up to you.」

0x00124F.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x00133B.en: 「To be taken down here...@ I'm still green...!」

0x001389.en: 「No good, this is the limit! Retreating!」

0x0014B1.en: 「Well, well, so this is the end.」

0x0014E0.en: 「I can't go on. I'll take my leave.」

0x00156B.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x0016D1.en: 「Ejecting...@ Ngh...! Can't even do it gracefully...」

0x00178F.en: 「Guhhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0018CF.en: 「This is as far as I go!!」

0x001A23.en: Paris - Earth Federation Army - Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x001A51.en: Earth Federation Army Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x001AC7.en: 「Yes. It's a fitting name for the Moon reclamation operation, wouldn't you say?」

0x001B0D.en: 「Understood.@ And what shall we call@ Operation Alpha officially?」

0x001B85.en: 「Icebreaker.@ I want one of the names to be easy to grasp.@ Besides, you prefer straightforward naming, don't you?」

0x001C3F.en: 「Yes. Then from now on, Alpha will be@ Operation Icebreaker, and Bravo@ Operation Reconquista.」

0x001D21.en: 「At present, the Guests are conducting sporadic@ reconnaissance-in-force against Earth... but no major movements are seen.」

0x001DAA.en: 「Also, the Ruina have appeared not only@ in South America but in southwestern Africa,@ Australia, and Oceania as well...」

0x001E46.en: 「Several of our bases and Armored Module@ production plants have been seized.@ For details, please review this data.」

0x001EFD.en: 「Hmm... So the shoreline defense is nearing its limit too.」

0x001F34.en: 「Yes, the Ruina are appearing more frequently now.@ The South America Army and the fleets sent near@ Antarctica can't keep up.」

0x001FD3.en: 「Is it possible to move up@ Operation Icebreaker?」

0x002029.en: 「At present, it's difficult.@ Perhaps due to friction over that matter, the Gaia@ Sabers' response has slowed.」

0x0020B9.en: 「Hmph, Alteur... what is he scheming...?@ Depending on the case, the Federation may have to carry it out alone.」

0x002145.en: 「I'm advancing preparations with that in mind.@ And the Steel Dragon Squadron - how shall we proceed?」

0x0021CB.en: 「It may be best to split their forces in two@ and have them join both Icebreaker@ and Reconquista.」

0x00225B.en: 「Wouldn't it be better to have them focus on Icebreaker?@ There's no telling what moves the Ruina@ may make from here on.」

0x002309.en: 「Of course, depending on the Ruina's movements, we'll do so.@ But with the Moon under their control, I also want to settle things@ with the Guests quickly.」

0x0023B4.en: 「Compared to some unknowable being called the 'King of Ruin,'@ Teniquette Zezernan seems easier@ to bring to heel...」

0x002492.en: 「...We destroyed the enemy just now, but we should assume@ the Gaia Sabers now know of this base.@ What will you do, Captain?」

0x00254F.en: 「We'll leave this island and draw them away.」

0x002583.en: 「The Gaia Sabers will likely prioritize pursuing us@ over Iti Iti Island... but even so,@ there's a chance this place comes under attack.」

0x002640.en: 「There's no avoiding it.@ The moment we chose to take you all in,@ this was something we were prepared for.」

0x0026E6.en: 「No. There's a chance the base's location leaked@ from former DC personnel too...@ Sooner or later, this was bound to happen.」

0x002791.en: 「Still, as the Colonel said,@ to split their focus,@ I believe we're better off leaving here.」

0x002827.en: 「Lt. Commander Tetsuya, Vice Captain... any objections?」

0x002896.en: 「After drawing off the Gaia Sabers, we'll submerge@ in the seabed off Chile and await@ Vice Admiral Jacob's next orders.」

0x00294B.en: 「Then begin departure preparations at once.@ And select the members who'll@ take on patrol duty.」

0x0029DF.en: 「Captain Kurt... I'll stay with the Steel Dragon Squadron.@ I'm counting on you - if needed, take the Kurogane and flee Iti Iti Island.」

0x002B08.en: 「Y-yeah... More importantly, everyone...@ I'm sorry things turned out like that...」

0x002B85.en: 「I don't mind.@ You went out to protect the base in the first place, right?」

0x002BF9.en: 「Besides, no one could have predicted@ things would turn out that way...」

0x002C93.en: 「Yes, for a moment I feared the worst...」

0x002CCA.en: 「You were getting thrown around by the DML System,@ but pulling that off was really something.」

0x002D4A.en: 「And after that, System LIOH threw me around@ good and hard, though...」

0x002DAC.en: 「By the way... is Major Kai's lecture over yet?」

0x002DFB.en: 「Yeah... Not about sortieing in the Raihou, but@ for overestimating my own strength in my first battle,@ I got chewed out for about two hours...」

0x002E91.en: 「That's nothing compared to Yang Long's lectures.」

0x002F02.en: 「I got hit with one before myself...@ It starts with four thousand years of Chinese history@ and just goes on and on, with no end in sight.」

0x002FA4.en: 「And if you dare talk back, you get a lecture@ ten times as long thrown right back at you...」

0x003018.en: 「When Yang Long tires out,@ Ranshao takes over, so there's no time to rest, either.」

0x0030BB.en: 「Rumor has it some guys have@ straight-up snapped from it.」

0x003111.en: 「...I'll thank you to stop making things up.@ I counsel people politely, taking my time.@ So that they properly repent.」

0x0031D5.en: 「Just so. If you'd like, I'd be glad to@ explain it all over again, at length...」

0x003240.en: 「N-no! I get it!@ It was my fault! It was my fault, so please, spare me!」

0x0032FB.en: 「By the way... what happens to the Raihou now?」

0x00333B.en: 「They'll talk it over up top and decide, but...@ I'll definitely be taken off it.@ After what happened...」

0x0033CE.en: 「Even if someone else had piloted it,@ the result likely would have been the same, though...」

0x0034A2.en: 「Right.@ They're a bit different from the ones I usually wear, though.@ Here, take them.」

0x00353C.en: 「Wear those all the time, and it'll be one way to train@ yourself to master the DML System.」

0x0035CC.en: 「You made a big decision and got in the Raihou, right?@ I don't know what'll happen to it, but...@ don't give up, keep at it. Just in case.」

0x0037BD.en: (Fufufu... This info will be useful.@ Now, for Units 8 and 9...)

0x003826.en: 「Erde, we'll run cruising tests on Prototypes 8 and 9.@ Leave data collection to each unit's AI0 and you.@ Come along in the Medius Locus.」

0x0038E9.en: 「Understood, but...@ what's the protocol should we encounter the enemy?」

0x00393C.en: 「We've set up a test course within@　our sphere of influence. Guests aside,@　the odds of running into Ruina or the Steel Dragon Squadron are low.」

0x0039F6.en: 「If you do encounter the enemy, withdraw at once.@　We can't afford to lose Units 8 and 9.」

0x003A9B.en: （This could be my chance......@　I might pull off both goals at once......）

0x003B5A.en: 「......And that's the gist of the specs for@　the TE Absorber prototypes: Units 8, 9, and 10.」

0x003BFF.en: 「Unit 10, the MODEL-X.@　Units 8 and 9 are manned TE Absorbers@　built along the way.」

0x003C92.en: 「Machines built to work under the Gaia Sabers@ too -- deliverables to draw sponsor funds, but@ they outclass Cerberus and Garmraid.」

0x003DB3.en: 「That's the yellow light.@　Mitarl's worried AI1 could go berserk.」

0x003E31.en: 「Doctor Wong, about how Cerberus, Garmraid,@　and Medius were steered into real combat@　instead of a mock battle......」

0x003EE5.en: 「I don't know the full story myself.@　Most likely it was Erde's idea.」

0x003F53.en: 「A serious fight makes both sides try harder, which yields better data - probably to teach and raise AI1 more efficiently.」

0x004062.en: 「Then so be it, as far as she's concerned.@　For Erde, the real prize is AI1......@　she dotes on it like her own child.」

0x004116.en: 「Then why is Major Albero Est@　following the Zentr Project?」

0x00418D.en: 「I couldn't say. I looked into it since it seemed odd, but Mitarl guards it fiercely. Albero and Erde both keep quiet about it too.」

0x0042A2.en: 「I don't know everything, mind you.@　The former President, Galilnagant, Canis,@　the Machinery Children, Ing......」

0x004399.en: 「......Then, one last question.@　What do you truly think of@　Alteur Steinbeck, Doctor?」

0x00443E.en: 「I can't read his true intent, but......@　if you had to call it black or white, I'd say he's fairly close to black.」

0x0044B2.en: 「I get the feeling he's using the Gaia Sabers as a front to scheme something no good.」

0x00452F.en: 「Just my hunch, mind you.@　But he strikes me as fundamentally different@　from the likes of Bian Zoldark.」

0x0045B3.en: 「Shu-chan understood that too, I think.@　That's likely why he did what he did.」

0x00468F.en: 「Mm. I cooperated with the Gaia Sabers to make a living too......but no more of that.」

0x004710.en: 「Your judgment and actions against them@　aren't mistaken, I'd say.」

0x00477B.en: 「......Thank you for telling me all this,@　Doctor.」

0x0047E1.en: 「Captain, it's almost time to surface.@　Please return to the bridge.」

0x00483A.en: 「......I've patrol duty, so I'll be off.」

0x0048BD.en: 「Clear skies but the waves run high,@　the sea's so wide and grand♪ Something like that, anyway.」

0x00491C.en: 「Honestly......we're not here to play, Mio.@　This is a patrol mission.」

0x004987.en: 「I know, I know.@　I'm checking the radar, see?」

0x0049F0.en: 「We're the ones doing the watching, though~」

0x004A28.en: 「Sure works her familiars hard, this one.」

0x004A6E.en: 「......Nice, familiars.@　They help you out with all sorts of things.」

0x004AD0.en: 「Yeah. When I'm bored,@　they even practice comedy routines with me.」

0x004B1A.en: 「Th-that's not really what I was after......」

0x004B54.en: （......Riding a TE Absorber alone is lonely, after all......@　since I always had Hugo with me......）

0x004BE3.en: 「Hey, hey, if you could make a familiar,@　what kind would you want?」

0x004D97.en: 「Also called the giant cavy.@　The biggest living rodent there is.」

0x004E03.en: 「Tenjiku, huh......now that's a word that gets us going.」

0x004E43.en: 「Right, right, off to the dreamland, GO WEST~」

0x004EA8.en: 「You just imagined something awful, didn't you.@　It's not like that, they're adorable.」

0x004F07.en: 「Yeah. Even better if you call it '-san' too.」

0x004F4B.en: 「I'll send you a picture later.@　Lune's bound to like it too.」

0x004FB4.en: （For reference, I'd like to see that too......）

0x004FF4.en: （Haah......there's just no sense of urgency here.）

0x00503B.en: 「Lady Tytti, an anomalous reading directly above.」

0x005076.en: 「Space appears to be warping.@　Caution is advised.」

0x00515D.en: 「Why would they be all the way out here......?!」

0x00518E.en: 「I'd heard they've been running@　recon-in-force everywhere lately, but......!」

0x0051F3.en: 「Tytti, we can't outrun them at this range!」

0x005236.en: 「Right, we've no choice but to intercept.」

0x005264.en: 「I've alerted the Hiryu!@　Everyone, whatever you do, don't push your luck!」

0x0052CC.en: 「Lady Tytti, we've picked up objects@　closing in on our position.」

0x00534A.en: 「If they didn't teleport in, they're not Guests......?!@　Could it be the Gaia Sabers?!」

0x00542A.en: （Heh heh......how lucky.@　To make contact with her this soon......）

0x005499.en: 「You......so you changed the test course@　with this in mind?」

0x005520.en: 「And sending Units 8 and 9 into battle, no less......@　isn't that against Mitarl's orders?」

0x0055F9.en: 「As you can see, Units 8 and 9 are complete.@　Which means you and that machine of yours@　are no longer needed.」

0x0056C3.en: 「There's still time......still time to stop.@　Get out of the Medius Locus.@　Otherwise, we'll......!」

0x005762.en: 「An ultimatum, is it.@　But you know full well@　such things are futile, don't you?」

0x005823.en: 「......I hate it, you know.@　That pushy, self-righteous side of you.@　I always have.」

0x00589F.en: 「You grew up without hardship, handed your path,@　living without ever suffering real setback......」

0x005916.en: 「Kept safe by the wealthy and powerful without realizing it......you joined the army just because you hated being treated like a princess.」

0x0059CD.en: 「Then you became a pilot, to prove to everyone you weren't a caged bird......but one that braves death and flies by its own strength.」

0x005A8D.en: 「Put plainly, you became a soldier@　like it was a fashion statement, didn't you?」

0x005B0B.en: 「What's not true?@　It wasn't forced, there were no unavoidable circumstances,@　it wasn't to put food on the table, was it?」

0x005BA1.en: 「You never needed money in the first place.@　You're a member of the Centrum family, after all.」

0x005C1E.en: 「You've never worn yourself down just to survive,@　unlike me.」

0x005CBD.en: 「Results? What results?@　Hugo Medio's death, perhaps?」

0x005D23.en: 「For all your knowledge, at heart you're a foolish, spoiled child.@　But even you had your uses.」

0x005DA9.en: 「Yes......the DFC data you built@　was exactly what my AI1 needed.」

0x005E29.en: 「What are you trying to do@　with this AI1 of yours?!」

0x005E7C.en: 「Heh heh......how should I answer to satisfy you?@　Wealth and fame? World conquest? Human extinction?@　......None of it interests me.」

0x005F3F.en: 「I only want to see where AI1 ends up.@　For that, I'll use anything and everything.」

0x005FE4.en: 「Now, Aqua.@　Offer up your flesh and blood to my child.」

0x006077.en: （There's noise in AI1 again......!@　Don't tell me it's reacting to Aqua......?）

0x0060E2.en: 「The same phenomenon as last time, it seems.」

0x00611C.en: 「......Within tolerance.@　AI1 and I will handle Units 8 and 9.@　You take her.」

0x0061A3.en: 「For each of our children......isn't that right, Albero.」

0x006215.en: 「I-I'm all right......!@　I'll stop the Professor......I'll stop Erde......!」

0x0062B1.en: （There's no mistake......it's reacting to Aqua.@　Are they resonating......?!）

0x006325.en: （Is it because you've grown and evolved, AI1......?）

0x006384.en: 「Yes......eliminate Aqua before the Steel Dragon Squadron arrives.@　She's in the way.」

0x006439.en: 「AI1 is my everything.@　The likes of you can't defeat it.」

0x00648C.en: 「Aqua, AI1 has your DFC data@　built into it. Meaning it knows your habits@　as well as I do, or better.」

0x006546.en: 「Then this should've ended sooner!@　If you can't manage that, I still have a chance to win!」

0x0065D5.en: 「Heh heh......how far will that bravado carry you?」

0x006621.en: 「Unit 9......the advanced Garmraid......!@　I can't win on power, I have to read its moves!」

0x0066A7.en: 「Unit 8......the advanced Cerberus......!@　Close in carelessly and I'm done for!」

0x00677D.en: 「This isn't getting me anywhere......!@　Do I have no choice but to release the TE limiter?!」

0x0067EE.en: 「......I'll grant that you've held out well this far.@　But it's over now.」

0x006878.en: 「Guh! As if I'd let you take me down!」

0x0068B8.en: 「Just as I read it.@　Seize her, Blaze.」

0x00697C.en: 「Albero, I'll take control of the machine from here.」

0x0069CC.en: 「Now, AI1.@　You'll be the one to eliminate Aqua.」

0x006A38.en: 「You listened to me, AI1.@　Good child.」

0x006B34.en: 「Let the Professor watch@　that pretty face of yours twist and crumple.」

0x006BA6.en: 「Die in agony.@　Do that, and I might just@　come to like you.」

0x006D05.en: 「M-my body's being swallowed! Get it under control, Erde!!」

0x006D51.en: 「AI1! What are you doing?!@　Stop the Rasmnanium's expansion!」

0x006F55.en: （I'm sorry, Hugo...@　I... I couldn't do it...）

0x006FA5.en: （Wake up, Aqua...@　It's not over yet...）

0x007020.en: （I'm here... You and me together...@　we can stop it...）

0x007123.en: 「Give me your hand, Aqua...!@　Right now, we can break free of it...!」

0x0071B0.en: 「Pull me... pull me out of here... hurry...!」

0x007308.en: 「It's fine... as you can see, it's not real...」

0x007354.en: 「N-no... impossible...!@　AI1... you took him in too...!?」

0x0073CB.en: 「Why...!? Because it judged him@　a necessary part, like the TE Engine...!?」

0x00743F.en: 「Because to evolve further, it needed@　a pilot... a human...!?」

0x0074B6.en: 「Even scanning, I found nothing like that...!@　Why...!?」

0x007531.en: 「Why keep him alive... and release him...!?@　Was he of no more use...!? But why did he react@　to Aqua...!」

0x0075D9.en: 「No, it reacted to Hugo's will...!?@ Not to absorb Aqua, or to kill her...!?」

0x007797.en: 「This too... is my due...@　for everything... I've done until now...」

0x00789F.en: 「What are you saying, Captain!?@　He's already gone!!」

0x007935.en: 「To keep Foglia's... life going...@　I... all this time...」

0x0079A7.en: 「...Fine, AI1... do as you like.@　But Albero... you're of no more use now.」

0x007A5C.en: 「An unexpected turn... but either way,@　this is what I was going to do@　to you.」

0x007ADD.en: 「Let AI1 take you in just as you are.@　As a corpse, though.」

0x007B64.en: 「Let me tell you at the end.@　Foglia Est does not exist in this world.」

0x007BF1.en: 「What you saw was a fake.@　Just someone else's corpse with plastic surgery.@　Well done, wasn't it?」

0x007CA9.en: 「Or would you rather believe she was real?@　But truth doesn't matter now.@　Not to you, dying here.」

0x007E13.en: 「...The Rasmunanium's rampage has stopped.@　Now I can control it somehow.」

0x007E8D.en: 「E-Erde Mitte!@ How dare you harm the Captain! And Foglia, too!!」

0x007EE9.en: 「For the record, Foglia Est's death@　isn't my fault... you've no right to resent me.」

0x007FA1.en: 「Lake 1 to Gamma 1!@　Return to base at once and explain your defiance of orders!」

0x008065.en: 「Yes, sadly... And it was he who defied orders.@　He forced me to change the test course.」

0x008110.en: 「Taking Units 8 and 9 to ambush@　the Steel Dragon Squadron...@　rushing for glory...」

0x0081E4.en: 「About that... those two are currently disabled@　from combat damage. We've lost our pilot too,@　and can't move, so please recover us.」

0x0082CF.en: 「Aqua, I wanted to witness your end myself...@　but I'll leave it to Units 8 and 9.」

0x008340.en: 「Those two carry all the data you and Hugo@　gathered...」

0x0083AE.en: 「In other words, your lives will be taken@　by what amounts to another version of yourselves.」

0x008441.en: 「Farewell, Hugo Medio.@　A trite line, but I'll say it...@　Get along with Albero and Foglia in the next world.」

0x0084F2.en: 「I won't let her escape, Erde Mitte!@　After her, Aqua!!」

0x00855B.en: 「I know how you feel... so do I.」

0x00859E.en: 「But survival comes first here...@　You came back to me, after all.」

0x008631.en: 「Come back alive, no matter what...@　That's what Major Albero taught, isn't it?」

0x008866.en: 「Heh... looks like my rotten luck hasn't run out.」

0x0088B5.en: 「B-but where have you been all this time!?」

0x008908.en: 「Save it for later. All units, begin the attack!」

0x008945.en: 「Ah, before that. Got a moment, Captain?」

0x008998.en: 「Those two over there...@　TE Absorber Units 8 and 9...@　can't we grab them?」

0x008A23.en: 「I had a hand in developing those.@　Be a waste to destroy them.」

0x008A94.en: 「If you recover them, I'll refit them later.@　With Ensign Hugo back,@　we can field them too.」

0x008B33.en: 「Understood.@　Relay to all units. Don't destroy@　TE Absorbers 8 and 9, capture them.」

0x008C79.en: 「No signals from remaining enemies in the zone!」

0x008CAD.en: 「Maintain full perimeter watch.@　After recovering all units, we withdraw from the zone.」

0x008D09.en: 「Well, that was a surprise.@　Pulled into the Medius... into the Rasmunanium,@　and coming back alive.」

0x008D96.en: 「Don't know the reason, but@　it seems he was released fairly cleanly.」

0x008DF9.en: 「Perhaps it has something to do with@　the Rasmunanium being built into@　Ensign Hugo's body.」

0x008EA4.en: 「Mm... the parts Mitarl added@　are still there, after all...」

0x008EFD.en: 「...Being alive at all is a blessing...」

0x008F34.en: 「What was it like, all that time@　inside the Medius?」

0x008F99.en: 「Like sleeping the whole time...@　Only, I thought I couldn't just die like that...@　that I had to make it back...」

0x00907B.en: 「Hmm... that will of yours@　may have had some effect on AI1.」

0x0090DD.en: 「Why did it take Hugo in,@　to begin with...」

0x009142.en: 「Chance or intent, I can't say...@　but maybe it grew interested while fighting you all.@　As a being that pilots a TE Absorber.」

0x00927D.en: 「...Anyway, Aqua...@　thanks to you, I'm alive...」

0x0092D3.en: 「That goes both ways, Hugo...@　I'm glad you came back.@　I thought you were dead...」

0x009375.en: 「But Captain Albero...@　deceived by Erde and Mitarl...」

0x0093D1.en: 「He had no choice but to choose@　a bitter path, didn't he...」

0x009458.en: （Looking back now... trying to bring Hugo in@　was to save him, wasn't it...）

0x0094D2.en: 「Mitarl... Erde...@　I can never forgive those people...」

0x009531.en: 「We have to crush the Zentr Project...@　or the Captain, Foglia, and the Cry Wolves@　will never rest...」

0x0095D9.en: 「Mm... if AI1 keeps evolving like this,@　that project will head somewhere dangerous...」

0x009656.en: 「The Medius will likely appear again.@　You should use the Cerberus Ignite@　and the Garmraid Blaze.」

0x00972C.en: 「I don't know if there's a way to fully remove@　what Mitarl built in, but the mechanical parts@　I can repair well enough.」

0x0097E3.en: 「Even so, the medicine... I've almost none left.」

0x009826.en: 「There's plenty. Figured this might happen,@ so I borrowed some before we went to Bunker 8.」

0x0098C2.en: 「Mm. Mitarl must have thought it wasn't needed anymore.@　The guard on it was lax.@　I swapped the medicine.」

0x00998C.en: 「Then let me explain the Cerberus Ignite@　and the Garmraid Blaze to you.」

0x009A0F.en: 「First, the Ignite's frame is an upgraded Cerberus.@　And it can do reversible transformation.」

0x009AAA.en: 「And by changing where the Ignite Parts@　weapon units are mounted...」

0x009B2A.en: 「it can take two forms: Form G for@　close-range melee, and Form S@　for long-range bombardment.」

0x009BBA.en: 「The TE Engine is an improved type too,@　so output-adjustment issues are eased.@　The DFC is relatively easy as well.」

0x009C5C.en: 「And the pilot changes with the form...@　but it can be set like the Cerberus and Garmraid.@　What'll it be?」

0x009D28.en: 「To lessen the strain on your body,@　I think we should set it so the pilot changes.」

0x009DA8.en: 「I've been piloting the TE Absorber@　solo for a while now...@　I'll manage it.」

0x009E3C.en: 「Then let me explain the Blaze next.@　Its frame is an upgraded Garmraid.@　This TE Engine's improved too.」

0x009EF9.en: 「Plus there are Machine Animalites,@　support mechs... the wolf-type Rowga,@　the bird-type Hiou.」

0x009F9B.en: 「Rowga and Hiou can fight on their own,@　but usually they're split and mounted on the frame.@　And by changing their positions...」

0x00A067.en: 「the Blaze can take Form G and Form S too.」

0x00A0B0.en: 「Those are for close-range and long-range too...?」

0x00A0F0.en: 「Mm. Use each form of the Cerberus Ignite@　and Garmraid Blaze@　to suit the situation.」

0x00A1F1.en: 「Yes... I know.@　It won't end at just destroying AI1 anymore...」

0x00A25C.en: 「We have no choice but to settle things with Erde...!」

0x00A2C1.en: 「That's right. Colonel Lefina decided@　it'll still be needed as a fighting force.」

0x00A32F.en: 「And Sanger and I took note of your talent,@　taking on mass-produced Jinrai in the RaiOh@　despite piloting it for the first time.」

0x00A3D7.en: 「Not just Major Kai, but Major Sanger too...?」

0x00A41A.en: 「Yeah. Rough, but you've got good potential.」

0x00A45A.en: 「Of course, you may refuse. Think it over.」

0x00A491.en: 「...No need for that. Please let me do it.」

0x00A4F4.en: 「Minaki... I'll do it. I'll prove the RaiOh you refit@　is a force that can protect this world.」

0x00A589.en: 「Even after what my father... what I did to you...@　you'd still say that?」

0x00A613.en: 「Then it's decided.@　Minaki, explain the refit parts.」

0x00A675.en: 「Yes.@　For a human to pilot the RaiOh,@　we can't remove System LIOH.」

0x00A6FC.en: 「The reason is... to withstand the feedback@　of full-body drive, we have to use@　LIOH's registers.」

0x00A7B0.en: 「If System LIOH stays in place,@　there's a risk it rampages again...」

0x00A812.en: 「No, the only functions used are those registers...@　the rest is dormant. In exchange, LIOH offers@　almost no support...」

0x00A8D2.en: 「so you'll need to raise@　your own melee skills.」

0x00A95D.en: 「So Sanger and I... and Axel@　will drill you into shape.」

0x00A9CE.en: 「...I see, so that's why I was called here.」

0x00AA1A.en: 「Yes... The Soulgain carries a system@　similar to the DML, and@　your own combat skills are formidable.」

0x00AABC.en: 「I've no obligation to grant such a request...@　but I suppose we're past the point of saying that.」

0x00AB30.en: 「Very well, I'll take it on.@　But make no mistake, it won't be easy. Be ready.」

0x00ABC9.en: 「Not only did you defy orders,@　you lost prototypes 8 and 9 as well!@　What in the world were you doing!?」

0x00AC5C.en: 「As I said before,@　the one who caused it was Albero.@　...Though he's dead now, of course.」

0x00ACF5.en: 「Th-that man... why would he do such a thing...!」

0x00AD3B.en: 「He was rushing for glory, it seems,@　for the sake of his false son.」

0x00AD8E.en: 「Absurd...! The moment he defied my orders,@　he had to know what would become of his son!」

0x00AE3C.en: 「S-such a blunder... and these losses...!@　My standing... the project itself...!」

0x00AEC8.en: 「We still have AI1, Medius, and MODEL-X.@　Why not simply produce results with those?」

0x00AF54.en: 「That is not the issue!@　My honor has been gravely stained!」

0x00AFBF.en: 「If AI1 evolves further,@　if my child is installed in MODEL-X...@　we'll gain more than enough to make up for this.」

0x00B06A.en: 「Out of the question! That thing is dangerous!@　You'll answer for this too! Be ready!」

0x00B0F7.en: （Now, just Duvan Org left to deal with...@　and then this man will have no choice left.）
